eKTP NIK and opening-form Nomor Identitas must match exactly and each contain 16 digits.
eKTP Nama and opening-form Nama Lengkap must have the same spelling; a minor abbreviation requires an audited matching signature comparison.
eKTP Nama and Join Visit Nama Nasabah must match exactly, without abbreviation exceptions.
eKTP and opening-form citizenship must match and use WNI or WNA.
eKTP Pekerjaan and opening-form Pekerjaan Utama must match verbatim. No inferred occupation-category equivalences.
Join Visit CIF and opening-form Nomor CIF must match exactly, preserving leading zeros. External CBS verification is excluded by user instruction.
EDD Nomor CIF and opening-form Nomor CIF must match exactly, preserving leading zeros.
EDD customer name and Informasi jabatan must match the company letter customer name and Jabatan Nasabah verbatim; employer signatory titles are excluded.
Signature-difference statement Nama and opening-form Nama Lengkap must match.
RIPLAY Nasabah (Nama) and opening-form Nama Lengkap must match; do not derive a blank name from a signature.
Company-letter customer name and Join Visit Nama Nasabah must match.
eKTP Nama and company-letter customer name must match identity.
eKTP birth place and full birth date must both match the opening-form Tempat/Tanggal Lahir.
eKTP gender must match opening-form gender: Laki-laki to Pria; Perempuan to Wanita.
NIK digits 7–12 agree with observed birth date and gender.
